[size=6][b]Description[/b]
[/size][size=4]  This content patch currently changes the Queen of Sauce to describe acts of cum-play which may or may not make sense in most situations, purely for the sake of [color=#d5a6bd]NSFW [/color]changes which I could not figure out a better description, suggestions are appreciated. It also changes the Fortune Teller and Weather Report for [color=#d5a6bd]sexier comments[/color] as well as [color=#d5a6bd]renaming [/color]them.
[color=#b6d7a8]  Most of [/color][color=#6aa84f]the original messages[/color][color=#b6d7a8] still stand but slightly changed, this is to [/color][color=#6aa84f]preserve information[/color][color=#b6d7a8] loss to a minimum and make the mod an addition and not a complete overhaul of the description as of now so that people would understand what each message still sends.

[/color][/size][b]TO-DO[/b][list]

[/list]
[size=6][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install the latest version of Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b][size=5]Support me on [url=https://ko-fi.com/taelf]Ko-fi!!![/url]
[/size][/b]
[size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.5 on Linux/Mac/Windows.
[*]Works in Single-player. Untested Multiplayer, should work tho.
[*][color=#e06666]Not compatible with mods that change TV messages or Images[/color]
[/list]
